Books & Catalogues
Browse the museum’s special exhibition catalogues and books that highlight the legacies of acclaimed women artists, past and present.
Shop Exhibition Catalogues , opens in new tab
Featured Publications
Collection Highlights
The cover of the exhibition catalogue Suchitra Mattai: Myth from Matter shows a close-up of one of Mattai’s layered textile and needlepoint artworks: a profile of a seated young girl in a yellow dress reading a book, with a halo-like arrangement of black beads around her head, set against a vibrant patchwork background.
New Worlds: Women to Watch 2024
Featuring full-color images and statements from the exhibition’s 28 artists, this catalogue presents works that reflect our extraordinary times, exploring themes of displacement, belonging, and ecological crisis.
Buy New Worlds , opens in new tab
The Sky’s the Limit
NMWA’s inaugural reopening exhibition features large-scale contemporary sculpture and immersive installations. Giving primacy to artists’ voices, the publication shares artists’ essays and poetry on the inspirations behind their work.
Buy The Sky’s the Limit , opens in new tab
A book cover features the image of a sculpture on a white base.
Paper Routes—Women to Watch 2020
This fully illustrated catalogue features personal statements by the exhibition’s twenty-two featured artists, who turn paper into innovative, complex works of art.

results.title: Nationalmuseum | Nationalmuseum shop
excerpts:
Home / Visit / Museum shop
In Nationalmuseum's shop, classic meets contemporary in carefully selected products of the highest quality. We offer a range of products connected to our temporary exhibitions, the museum itself, and our vast collections of art, applied arts and design. There's something for most tastes, ages, and budgets.
Just in time for the opening of the exhibitions Fantasy and Reality – The Art of Johan Tobias Sergel and Badin – Beyond Surface and Mask at the end of February, the museum shop was given a refresh, featuring new comfortable seating for those who want to rest for a while or browse through books, as well as even better opportunities to showcase our
art and design-related selection. You can see a few glimpses of the new interior below.
Nationalmuseum Shop. Photo: Anna Danielsson/Nationalmuseum.
Nationalmuseum Shop. Photo: Anna Danielsson/Nationalmuseum.

Nationalmuseum Shop.
Our online bookshop carries a wide selection of art and design books published by Nationalmuseum, including exhibition catalogues and research publications. We also have a marvellous range of books for children.
Contact the shop

Note that the shop closes 15 minutes before the rest of the museum closes.

results.full_content:
# Nationalmuseum's bookshop

Welcome to the Nationalmuseum’s bookshop. Here you will find the museum’s entire publishing of books on photography, arts and crafts, form and design, painting and sculpture, drawing and graphics.

There is something here for everyone: Art books for children, beautiful picture books for adults, books relating to temporary exhibitions and books presenting the museum’s research on the collections.

You can easily order the titles wherever you are, we will dispatch within three business days. The books are sold and distributed by eddy.se AB.
